title: A dog's walk round the park
checked: Every reachable state checked (11 states, 14 with their data, 19 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 11 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: On the lead by the road
rules.says: At the gate, the lamp post, the kiosk and on the way home, the dog is always on the lead.
rules.path: Take away the back at the gate guard and it breaks in 5 steps: set off, next step, next step, let him off, go home.

rules.says: Past the ducks the dog is on the lead, so it never jumps in the pond.
rules.path: Take away the on the lead guard and it breaks in 5 steps: set off, next step, next step, let him off, next step.

rules.rule: The walk ends at the gate
rules.says: The dog goes home only from the gate, after the whole loop.
rules.path: Take away the back at the gate guard and it breaks in 1 step: go home.
